## GET `/api/2.29/network-interfaces/ping`

**Tier:** T0  

Display network interface ping result.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `X-Request-ID` | header | string |  | Supplied by client during request or generated by server. |
| `component_name` | query | string |  | Used by ping and trace to specify where to run the operation. Valid values are controllers and blades from hardware list. If not specified, defaults to all available controllers and selected blades. |
| `count` | query | integer (int32) |  | Used by ping to specify the number of packets to send. If not specified, defaults to 1. |
| `destination` | query | string | yes | A destination specified by user to run the network diagnosis against. Can be a hostname or an IP. |
| `packet_size` | query | integer (int32) |  | Used by ping to specify the number of data bytes to be sent per packet. If not specified, defaults to 56. |
| `print_latency` | query | boolean |  | Used by ping to specify whether or not to print the full user-to-user latency. If not specified, defaults to false. |
| `resolve_hostname` | query | boolean |  | Used by ping and trace to specify whether or not to map IP addresses to host names. If not specified, defaults to true. |
| `source` | query | string |  | Used by ping and trace to specify the property where to start to run the specified operation. The property can be subnet or IP. |

**Responses:** `200` OK → `NetworkInterfacePingGetResponse`

| `resolve_hostname` | query | boolean |  | Used by ping and trace to specify whether or not to map IP addresses to host names. If not specified, defaults to true. |
